ValidationRule.description: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Visa Type and Destination Country are required once the application leaves Draft, so a Draft can be part-filled in any order.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Draft")), OR( ISBLANK(First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Last_Name__c), ISBLANK(Date_of_Birth__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Visa_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Destination_Country__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, Visa Type and Destination Country are required before submitting.
